basic_details.short_information: The Kerala State Medical Councils (കേരള സംസ്ഥാന മെഡിക്കൽ കൗൺസിൽസ്), Thiruvananthapuram, has invited applications for 1 Clerk/Typist post, falling vacant from 1 December 2026, on foreign service terms. Only employees working in a similar post in State Government, semi-government or public sector establishments may apply. Applications go by post, through proper channel, to the Registrar, Kerala State Medical Councils, Red Cross Road, Thiruvananthapuram-35, and must reach by 5.00 PM on 11 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About KSMC
content_sections.text: The Kerala State Medical Councils is the body whose office is at Redcross Road, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, 695035. The notice is issued over the signature of the Registrar, with the notice date 26 November 2026. The post is in the Council's own office.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent to: Registrar, Kerala State Medical Councils, Red Cross Road, Thiruvananthapuram-35. The application must be submitted through proper channel. It must be in the form specified under Rule 144 of KSR Part I. The No Objection Certificate from the head of the department concerned and the bio-data must be attached. The application must reach the Registrar by 5.00 PM on 11 December 2026. The notice does not mention a postal mode or any text to be written on the envelope. Further details are on the website www.medicalcouncil.kerala.gov.in .
